items.name: CheckpointWriteResult
items.summary: Result of attempting to write a checkpoint file.

items.name: ChecksumWriteResult
items.summary: Result of attempting to write a version checksum (CRC) file.

items.name: Snapshot
items.summary: In-memory representation of a specific snapshot of a Delta table. While a `DeltaTable` exists throughout time, `Snapshot`s represent a view of a table at a specific point in time; they have a defined schema (which may change over time for…

methods.name: alter_table
methods.summary: Creates a builder for altering this table's metadata. Currently supports schema change operations.

methods.name: builder_for
methods.summary: Create a new [`SnapshotBuilder`] to build a new [`Snapshot`] for a given table root. If you instead have an existing [`Snapshot`] you would like to do minimal work to update, consider using [`Snapshot::builder_from`] instead.

methods.name: builder_from
methods.summary: Create a new [`SnapshotBuilder`] to incrementally update an existing [`Snapshot`] to a more recent version.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.signature: fn checkpoint(&SnapshotRef, engine: &dyn Engine, spec: Option<&CheckpointSpec>) -> DeltaResult<(CheckpointWriteResult, SnapshotRef)>
methods.summary: Performs a complete checkpoint of this snapshot using the provided engine.

methods.name: crc
methods.summary: Returns the CRC for this snapshot, if one is resolved.

methods.name: create_checkpoint_writer
methods.summary: Creates a [`CheckpointWriter`] for generating a checkpoint from this snapshot.

methods.name: estimated_owned_heap_size_bytes
methods.summary: Estimated owned heap size in bytes for this snapshot. Best-effort estimate for capacity tracking, not authoritative.

methods.name: get_all_domain_metadata
methods.summary: Fetch all non-internal domain metadata for this snapshot as a `Vec`.

methods.name: get_app_id_version
methods.signature: fn get_app_id_version(&self, application_id: &str, engine: &dyn Engine) -> DeltaResult<Option<i64>>
methods.summary: Fetch the latest version of the provided `application_id` for this snapshot. Filters the txn based on the delta.setTransactionRetentionDuration property and lastUpdated.

methods.name: get_domain_metadata
methods.signature: fn get_domain_metadata(&self, domain: &str, engine: &dyn Engine) -> DeltaResult<Option<String>>
methods.summary: Fetch the domainMetadata for a specific domain in this snapshot. This returns the latest configuration for the domain, or None if the domain does not exist.

methods.name: get_domain_metadata_internal
methods.signature: fn get_domain_metadata_internal(&self, domain: &str, engine: &dyn Engine) -> DeltaResult<Option<String>>
methods.summary: Fetch both user-controlled and system-controlled domain metadata for a specific domain in this snapshot.

methods.name: get_domain_metadatas_internal
methods.signature: fn get_domain_metadatas_internal(&self, engine: &dyn Engine, domains: Option<&HashSet<&str>>) -> DeltaResult<std::collections::HashMap<String, actions::DomainMetadata>>
methods.summary: Load domain metadata: if Complete in the CRC, answer from the cache; else if every requested domain is in a Partial cache, also answer from the cache; else full log replay. `domains == None` means load all.

methods.name: get_file_stats_if_present
methods.summary: Returns file-level statistics, or `None` if this snapshot has no CRC, or its CRC does not have `Complete` file stats. Performs no I/O (the CRC is resolved at construction).

methods.name: get_in_commit_timestamp
methods.summary: Get the In-Commit Timestamp (ICT) for this snapshot.

methods.name: get_logical_clustering_columns
methods.summary: Get the logical clustering columns for this snapshot, if clustering is enabled.

methods.name: get_physical_clustering_columns
methods.summary: Get the clustering columns for this snapshot, if the table has clustering enabled.

methods.name: get_protocol_derived_properties
methods.summary: Returns the protocol-derived table properties as a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: get_timestamp
methods.summary: Get the timestamp for this snapshot's version, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

methods.name: incremental_scan_builder
methods.summary: Create an [`IncrementalScanBuilder`] for the range `(base_version, self.version()]`.

methods.name: log_compaction_writer
methods.signature: fn log_compaction_writer(Arc<self>, start_version: Version, end_version: Version) -> DeltaResult<LogCompactionWriter>
methods.summary: Creates a [`LogCompactionWriter`] for generating a log compaction file.

methods.name: log_segment
methods.summary: Log segment this snapshot uses

methods.name: metadata_configuration
methods.summary: Get the raw metadata configuration for this table.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(log_segment: LogSegment, table_configuration: TableConfiguration) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Snapshot`] from a [`LogSegment`] and [`TableConfiguration`].

methods.name: publish
methods.signature: fn publish(&SnapshotRef, engine: &dyn Engine, committer: &dyn Committer) -> DeltaResult<SnapshotRef>
methods.summary: Publishes all catalog commits at this table version. Applicable only to catalog-managed tables. This method is a no-op for filesystem-managed tables or if there are no catalog commits to publish.

methods.name: scan_builder
methods.summary: Create a [`ScanBuilder`] for an `SnapshotRef`.

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Table [`Schema`] at this `Snapshot`s version.

methods.name: table_configuration
methods.summary: Get the [`TableConfiguration`] for this [`Snapshot`].

methods.name: table_properties
methods.summary: Get the [`TableProperties`] for this [`Snapshot`].

methods.name: transaction
methods.signature: fn transaction(Arc<self>, committer: Box<dyn Committer>, engine: &dyn Engine) -> DeltaResult<Transaction>
methods.summary: Create a [`Transaction`] for this `SnapshotRef`. With the specified [`Committer`].

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(log_segment: LogSegment, table_configuration: TableConfiguration) -> DeltaResult<Self>
methods.summary: Create a new [`Snapshot`] from a [`LogSegment`] and [`TableConfiguration`].

methods.name: version
methods.summary: Version of this `Snapshot` in the table.

methods.name: write_checksum
methods.signature: fn write_checksum(&SnapshotRef, engine: &dyn Engine) -> DeltaResult<(ChecksumWriteResult, SnapshotRef)>
methods.summary: Writes a version checksum (CRC) file for this snapshot. Writers should call this after every commit because checksums enable faster snapshot loading and table state validation.

items.name: SnapshotRef
items.summary: A shared, thread-safe reference to a [`Snapshot`].
